evidence.api_compatibility: No API, CLI, config, or behavior changes. This is a documentation-only change and introduces no breaking changes.
evidence.documentation: This PR is itself a documentation change. It adds a Release Admin Access section listing four required permissions (SignPath, release branch push, release tag push, Discord #announcements) and clarifies that tools/release.py must be run locally with your own git credentials on origin. The new text is consistent with the rest of the release.md document. The CodeRabbit finding about --remote and version calculation is a valid observation about the script itself but falls outside the scope of this documentation update; the script would need a separate PR to fix.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The change is purely to documentation. A human exercising the release process would encounter the clarified text, but no behavior change occurs. No manual testing is needed.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The PR contained a single commit (67f4945) which was the sole commit approved by @jeremyfowers. The merge commit (b258334) is the squash/merge of that single commit.
evidence.review: The PR was approved by @jeremyfowers (admin maintainer with CI and governance subject-area expertise) on 2026-10-28T13:08:51Z with the comment 'Thanks for these updates, it will make things much smoother for the next person!' The review was appropriate — a subject-matter expert in CI/governance reviewed documentation changes to the release process. CodeRabbit flagged one concern: tools/release.py calculates versions from origin/main rather than the --remote-selected branch, meaning --remote could produce a tag number that diverges from the tested candidate. This is a pre-existing bug in the script that the documentation does not fix, but it is a corner case for operators using a non-default upstream remote and does not affect the standard workflow.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The PR does not add or modify code, credentials handling, network calls, or permissions. It documents existing permissions that release admins must hold.
evidence.tests: No automated tests apply to this PR — it changes only docs/dev/release.md (13 lines added, 1 removed). Documentation updates of this kind do not carry unit or integration tests.

subject: update release process (#3979)
summary: Enhances the release guide by documenting release admin access requirements (SignPath, release branch/tag push, Discord announcements) and clarifying that tools/release.py must be run locally on the machine rather than in CI, including a note about using --remote for non-default upstream remotes.
verdict_reason: This is a documentation-only PR that clarifies release admin permissions and local execution of the release script; it was reviewed by an admin maintainer with CI/governance expertise and merged with all CI checks passing.
